round.summary: In the current lowered configuration, the U-Shaped Tilt Yoke sits too low on the Weighted Base Stand, causing solid overlap between the yoke crossbar and the PWM Speed Controller PCB as well as collisions between the Circular Rear & Perimeter Safety Grille, the Knurled Speed Knob, and the Weighted Base Stand across the -45 to +45 degree tilt sweep. Raising the U-Shaped Tilt Yoke to the upper declared limit of 78 mm in Y restores full clearance across all sampled tilt poses while keeping the stand at least 10 mm shorter than the original reference and preserving all component shapes and the sourced 608 Axle Ball Bearing.

observations.detail: The lowered U-Shaped Tilt Yoke is currently positioned at 48 mm in Y, where its lower horizontal bar intersects the PWM Speed Controller PCB and places the fan head too low to clear the Knurled Speed Knob and Weighted Base Stand.

Across the -45 to +45 degree tilt range relative to the resting head angle, the Circular Rear & Perimeter Safety Grille collides with the Knurled Speed Knob between -20 and +20 degrees and with the Weighted Base Stand between 0 and +45 degrees.

The sampled motion clearance check fails across all 19 recorded poses with 0 mm minimum clearance due to contact between the U-Shaped Tilt Yoke and PWM Speed Controller PCB, as well as between the Circular Rear & Perimeter Safety Grille and the base components.
The U-Shaped Tilt Yoke placement is within the declared vertical adjustment bounds and can be raised solely along Y to 78 mm within those limits.
All original component solid shapes and dimensions are preserved unchanged across the assembly.

The sourced 608 Axle Ball Bearing (22 mm outer diameter, 8 mm bore, 7 mm width) is retained intact with its catalog reference and seated between the Tilted Motor Pod & Bearing Boss and the 8 mm Stainless Drive Axle.

parts.name: Weighted Base Stand
parts.description: Heavy cast-metal and polymer desktop base housing the speed control PCB and anti-slip feet.
parts.role: Heavy cast-metal and polymer desktop base housing the speed control PCB and anti-slip feet.

parts.name: PWM Speed Controller PCB
parts.description: Internal low-voltage DC motor controller board with rotary potentiometer, inductor, and USB-C power input.
parts.role: Internal low-voltage DC motor controller board with rotary potentiometer, inductor, and USB-C power input.

parts.name: Knurled Speed Knob
parts.description: Machined aluminum rotary dial on the front of the base for stepless fan speed control.
parts.role: Machined aluminum rotary dial on the front of the base for stepless fan speed control.

parts.name: U-Shaped Tilt Yoke
parts.description: Rigid curved support arm bolted to the base that cradles the fan head between dual pivot trunnions.
parts.role: Rigid curved support arm bolted to the base that cradles the fan head between dual pivot trunnions.

parts.name: Tilt Locking Thumb Knobs
parts.description: Left and right threaded clamping knobs that lock the fan head at the desired upward tilt angle.
parts.role: Left and right threaded clamping knobs that lock the fan head at the desired upward tilt angle.

parts.name: Tilted Motor Pod & Bearing Boss
parts.description: Vented rear nacelle tilted upward by 12 degrees, featuring a precision 22 mm front pocket for the 608 axle bearing.
parts.role: Vented rear nacelle tilted upward by 12 degrees, featuring a precision 22 mm front pocket for the 608 axle bearing.

parts.name: Brushless DC Drive Motor
parts.description: High-efficiency internal brushless DC motor core with copper stator windings and rear flux ring.
parts.role: High-efficiency internal brushless DC motor core with copper stator windings and rear flux ring.

parts.name: 8 mm Stainless Drive Axle
parts.description: Precision ground 8 mm stainless steel shaft coupling the motor rotor through the 608 bearing to the three-blade hub.
parts.role: Precision ground 8 mm stainless steel shaft coupling the motor rotor through the 608 bearing to the three-blade hub.

parts.name: 608 Axle Ball Bearing
parts.description: Sourced 608 deep-groove ball bearing (8 mm bore, 22 mm OD, 7 mm width) seated in the front motor boss to support axial and radial rotor loads.
parts.role: 608 bearing: 8 mm bore, 22 mm outer diameter, 7 mm width.
parts.notes: Sourced NopSCADlib geometry, tessellated and centered in millimetres (Y up). Placement, finish and annotations are editable. Standard dimensions are preserved. Source CAD does not verify fit, wiring, load capacity or operation of this assembly. License: GPL-3.0-or-later.

parts.name: Circular Rear & Perimeter Safety Grille
parts.description: Open-front wire and ring safety cage with radial struts and concentric rings framing the exposed rotor.
parts.role: Open-front wire and ring safety cage with radial struts and concentric rings framing the exposed rotor.

parts.name: Exposed Three-Blade Rotor
parts.description: High-visibility orange three-blade aerodynamic impeller with a machined aluminum nose cone mounted directly ahead of the 608 bearing.
parts.role: High-visibility orange three-blade aerodynamic impeller with a machined aluminum nose cone mounted directly ahead of the 608 bearing.

steps.title: Base & PWM Speed Control
steps.description: Place the PWM speed controller PCB inside the weighted desktop base and press the knurled aluminum speed knob onto the vertical potentiometer shaft.

steps.title: Tilt Yoke & Motor Pod
steps.description: Mount the U-shaped tilt yoke to the base pedestal, position the vented motor housing at its 12-degree upward tilt, and secure both side trunnions with the locking thumb knobs.

steps.title: Motor, Axle & Sourced 608 Bearing
steps.description: Install the brushless DC motor inside the housing, slide the 8 mm stainless drive axle through the motor, and press the sourced 608 ball bearing (8 mm bore, 22 mm OD) into the front nose boss.

steps.title: Circular Grille & Exposed Three-Blade Rotor
steps.description: Fasten the open-front circular safety grille around the motor pod and press the high-visibility three-blade rotor hub onto the protruding 8 mm axle in front of the 608 bearing.

relationships.description: Weighted base encloses the PWM motor speed controller PCB.
Knurled aluminum speed knob couples to the potentiometer shaft on the control PCB.
PWM controller delivers variable-duty DC power through the yoke cable to the brushless motor.
U-shaped tilt yoke bolts rigidly to the top pedestal of the weighted base.
Tilt yoke cradles the motor housing side trunnions at a 12-degree upward angle.
Threaded thumb knobs clamp the yoke arms against the motor housing trunnions to lock the tilt angle.
Vented rear motor pod houses the brushless DC stator and rotor.
Front 22 mm nose pocket of the motor housing seats the outer race of the sourced 608 ball bearing.
Brushless DC motor drives the 8 mm stainless steel fan axle.
Sourced 608 bearing supports the 8 mm fan axle with low-friction rolling contact.
Front end of the 8 mm axle press-fits into the exposed three-blade rotor hub.
Circular safety grille mounts to the motor housing perimeter and pivot bosses.
